title: feat(spec): push delivery data names the server that sent it — RegisterDeviceRequest, UserDevice and PushDeliveryData gain an optional origin
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzeYAsmoHHYA59sCBZa

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBQgSBJZBjCuYUW1nMNHz3yx)_
Fixes #29642

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches device registration or push delivery data (a `git grep -i` of `skills/` for `push`, `device`, `notifications/devices` and `window.location.origin` names only unrelated lines: `Array.push` calls, query push-down, and the viewport and touch-device notes in `skills/objectui/guides/mobile.md`), so no taught line changes.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设备注册请求 `RegisterDeviceRequest`、设备记录 `UserDevice`、推送数据 `PushDeliveryData` 各加一个可选字段 `origin`，同一条规则：`http(s)://` + 小写主机 + 可选端口，不带路径。
- 为什么改：App 里存了多台服务器时，点开 B 服务器发来的推送会在 A 上打开；按裁决 B，由 Console 注册时报上自己的来源，服务器存进设备记录，推送原样带回，App 按它选服务器。
- 风险与回滚：纯放宽，三个字段都可选，不带它的请求照旧通过；唯一新增的拒收是注册时带了格式不对的 `origin`（今天没有客户端会发）。服务器暂不存、推送暂不带，设备侧两个字段标了 `[PLANNED — not yet stored]`。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/push-server-origin.ts`（共享的正则和拒收文案），再看 `push-server-origin.test.ts`（三个字段同一组接受/拒收用例）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/push-server-origin.test.ts`，预期 68 个测试全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## The ruling

「Ruling: batch #1 item 1 · letter B · maintainer 「同意」 2026-11-03T02:26Z」 (record 6593872191): **Option B:** "the Console sends the origin it was loaded from in `RegisterDeviceRequest`. The server stores it on the `UserDevice` row, and the push channel copies it into `PushDeliveryDataSchema`. All three are new optional members." #29218 has merged, so this is its own spec PR widening three optional members.

## The name: `origin`

`packages/spec` already spells a URL origin `origin`: the action `navigate` template's `${ctx.origin}` (`ui/action.zod.ts`, the `navigate` describe, "`${ctx.*}` (origin/apiBase/user/org/recordId/selection)"; the Console fills it with `window.location.origin`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/MetadataTypeActions.tsx`), and CORS `origins` (`shared/http.zod.ts`, values like `https://app.example.com`). `serverOrigin` has zero hits in `packages/spec/src`. The value is exactly `window.location.origin`, so the one name is `origin` on all three schemas.

## What changes

- **`system/push-server-origin.ts` (new, internal).** `PUSH_SERVER_ORIGIN_PATTERN` and `PUSH_SERVER_ORIGIN_MESSAGE`, the one rule the three members share. It follows the `system/push-device-platform.ts` precedent: no barrel re-exports it, so it adds no public name (`api-surface/` is unchanged), and each schema builds its own `z.string().regex(...)` from it. The pattern accepts `http://` or `https://`, a lowercase host (DNS labels, punycode included, or a bracketed IPv6 address) and an optional `:PORT`, and nothing after it. That is the serialized form `window.location.origin` answers, so the shell can compare it with a saved server byte for byte.
- **`RegisterDeviceRequestSchema.origin`** (`api/protocol.zod.ts`): the Console writes it at registration. Describe opens with `[PLANNED — not yet stored]`.
- **`UserDeviceSchema.origin`** (`system/push-device.zod.ts`): the registration's value, kept on the row. Same marker.
- **`PushDeliveryDataSchema.origin`** (`api/push-delivery.zod.ts`): the push channel copies it from the device; the shell opens the tap on the saved server with that origin and resolves `route` there. The schema-level `[PLANNED — not yet served]` marker stays, and its describe now names the origin. The file's docblock gains a "Which server sent it" paragraph.
- **Generated:** `authorable-surface/api.json` (+`api/PushDeliveryData:origin`, +`api/RegisterDeviceRequest:origin`), `authorable-surface/system.json` (+`system/UserDevice:origin`), and the three `content/docs/references/**` pages (`api/protocol.mdx`, `api/push-delivery.mdx`, `system/push-device.mdx`), written by `gen:docs`.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/29642-push-server-origin.md`, `@objectstack/spec` minor, carrying both declaration lines.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/system/push-server-origin.test.ts`, 68 cases, `describe.each` over the three carriers so each member is held to the same rule:

- optional: the body without `origin` parses unchanged (no `origin` key appears);
- five valid origins round-trip: `https://crm.example.com`, `http://localhost:3000`, a punycode host with a port, an IPv4 host with a port, `http://[::1]:3000`;
- sixteen refusals, each answering exactly one issue at path `['origin']` with code `invalid_format` and the one shared message: a trailing `/`, a path, a query, a fragment; `ftp:`, `wss:`, `javascript:`; a bare host, a bare host with a port, a protocol-relative `//host`; an upper-case scheme, an upper-case host, user info, an empty port, a leading space, the empty string;
- one contract: all three JSON Schemas publish the same `pattern` and none lists `origin` as required;
- the markers: both device-side members open with `[PLANNED — not yet stored]`, and the push data keeps its schema-level `[PLANNED — not yet served]`.

**Ablation** (fix committed first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the pattern line of `push-server-origin.ts`, replaced with `/[\s\S]*/;`): Tests 48 failed | 20 passed (68). Every refusal case went red on all three carriers (16 × 3); the optional, valid and contract cases stayed green. Restored: blob equals HEAD (`8c3209e4`), `git diff HEAD` empty. The suite imports the schemas from source, so no `dist/` was involved.

## Acceptance notes

- **`Metadata-protocol: added`, not `none`.** All three schemas are listed on `packages/spec/authorable-surface/`, and adding the members moved two shards. `check-changeset-no-major` refuses `none` over a moved authorable-surface shard, so the kind is `added` and `@objectstack/spec` takes `minor`. The claim's `none` line needs amending to match.
- **No liveness rows.** None of the three schemas is a governed metadata type (`packages/spec/liveness/` has no row for any of them), and `check:liveness` is green with no change.
- **Iso_ pins hold unchanged.** `Iso_api_protocol__RegisterDeviceRequestSchema`, `Iso_api_pushDelivery__PushDeliveryDataSchema` and `Iso_system_pushDevice__UserDeviceSchema` in `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` still assert input equals output: an optional string with no default or transform keeps them equal. No new export, so no new pin.
- **No refinement.** The rule is a `.regex()`, which the JSON Schema projects, so `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` does not move.
- **The one new refusal.** From this release, `POST /api/v1/notifications/devices` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/notifications.ts`, which `safeParse`s the body with `RegisterDeviceRequestSchema`) refuses a registration whose `origin` is malformed. Before, an unknown `origin` key was stripped. No client sends one today: `git grep` for a `registerDevice` caller under `ui/` finds none.
- **The producers are not in this PR** (named for the `domain:server` follow-up):
  - `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/user-device.object.ts`: `sys_user_device` has no `origin` field (beside `app_id` and `locale`).
  - `packages/services/service-messaging/src/device-registry.ts`: the row write (`app_id: request.appId ?? null`, `locale: …`) and the row read (`if (row.locale) device.locale = …`) carry no `origin`.
  - The push channel (#29041): nothing outside `packages/spec` produces `PushDeliveryData` yet (`git grep PushDeliveryData -- packages ':!packages/spec'` is empty).
  - The Console registration call rides #29042.
  - That follow-up takes the `[PLANNED — not yet stored]` markers off and flips the marker pin in `push-server-origin.test.ts`.
- `packages/client` `registerDevice(request: RegisterDeviceRequest)` widens with the type and needs no edit.

## Verification

All on head `2aa2ae0a7` (base `9b4fa6cc`; `origin/main` has since moved to `3eeb81d19`, and none of its changed files is in this diff — the one shared directory, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/`, moved only `data.json` there — so no merge was made).
